necessary_context.content: Phi(x)=f(x,y*(x)), y*(x)=argmin_y g(x,y). Euclidean vector norms and induced operator norms. Global population regularity and conditionally unbiased fresh full-gradient observations are separate assumptions. Each call selects f or g; receiving both costs two calls. Quantitative high-order bounds concern lower-variable derivative fields, not arbitrary high derivatives in x.
necessary_context.locator: Section 2, printed pp.5–6, Assumptions 1–2 and Definition 2.1
necessary_context.name: Population and oracle scope

necessary_context.content: Appendix A constructs a local estimator of J_y grad g(x,y)[v]. Its conditional mean is the discrete Chebyshev difference; the derivative approximation has a separate deterministic bias. Appendix A.3 is a section, not Lemma A.3.
